verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents AI summaries and automatic labels on scanned mail, which implies the scans' content is extracted. Its official MCP server can "find mail", with an example of locating a letter by sender and reading what it says. There is no explicit OCR claim and no documented in-app search by sender, content, or date. Missing for 10: explicit OCR documentation, a searchable archive UI or API search with sender/content/date filters, date-based search evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, scans are OCR'd and my mail archive is searchable by sender, content, and date

citations.quote: Get instant AI summaries and automatic labels that help you stay on top of your mail
manage your virtual mailbox just by asking - find mail, organize your inbox, scan or shred items, and more
Unlimited cloud storage applies to digitized mail.
